AssertCondition.name: AC-ValidateMcpRequest
AssertCondition.Condition: (request.verb = "POST" or request.verb = "GET" or request.verb = "DELETE") and (request.verb != "POST" or (request.header.Content-Type =| "application/json" and (request.header.Content-Length = null or request.header.Content-Length <= 262144))) and NOT (request.uri ~~ "(?i).*(\.\.|%2e|%2f|%5c|;).*")
